# PRD title

## Product intent
State the bounded outcome and why it matters.

## Scope and non-goals
Define included behavior and explicit exclusions.

## Success criteria
State observable acceptance criteria.

## Starting baseline and impact
Reference the accepted baseline, domains, facts, constraints, and Feedback.
